title: A town guard: on duty, good eyes, brave, quick
note: SANDBOX (by design: broad and diverse profiles, each with traits). Traits 0 to 1; SightRange in metres (daylight, open ground, a running body), ConeDegrees the half-angle, NoticeSeconds, MakeOutSeconds, ConcludeSeconds (each step up the ladder), HoldSeconds and CoolDownSeconds (calming down) in seconds (the proposed values). By design, an armed guard is "more inclined to investigate". At night he sees a running body 30 x 0.405 = 12.2 m off. "duel" is how one of this kind fights when it does (the duelling brain's numbers by the arena's names; the rest the brain's defaults), SANDBOX.
